title: Help Reduce Single-Use plastic!
description:
Small choices add up. This Plastic Free July, join millions of people in reducing their plastic waste. Start by swapping one thing to reduce single-use plastic. A few simple swaps can make a huge difference that helps reduce waste, conserve resources, and protect our environment. Bring reusable bags when you shop, keep a reusable bottle or cup nearby, skip single-use utensils when possible, recycle accepted items correctly, and keep plastic bags out of curbside recycling.
 
To learn more about the challenge, visit PlasticFreeJuly.org. For more information about what’s recyclable and San Diego’s Single Use Plastic Reduction Ordinance, visit sandiego.gov/SUPRO.
